title: Inventory Count Form
subtitle: Warehouse Inventory Count: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Inventory Count Form covers item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance. The inventory control coordinator records Warehouse Inventory Count activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Inventory Count Form keeps Warehouse Inventory Count exceptions visible until the inventory control coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Inventory Count Form at warehouse zone, bin, staging location, quarantine area, and system record. Document item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance identity before Warehouse Inventory Count begins. Compare item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance findings with stated Warehouse Inventory Count criteria; route unresolved Warehouse Inventory Count issues to authorized inventory reviewer. For Inventory Count Form, confirm requirements for Warehouse Inventory Count. Ask authorized inventory reviewer to review Warehouse Inventory Count conditions beyond the inventory control coordinator's role.

sections.title: Task record and responsible parties
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Inventory Count, identify responsible parties, warehouse zone, bin, staging location, quarantine area, and system record, and the linked item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance source.

fields.label: Item, lot, serial, unit, and location
System snapshot, freeze time, and prior transaction reference

sections.title: Activity observations and operating checks
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Inventory Count facts for item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Warehouse Inventory Count operating checks
items: Recent receipt, pick, transfer, or adjustment
Variance cause, hold, approval, and posting

sections.title: Activity result and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Resolve open Warehouse Inventory Count conditions; have inventory control coordinator assign the next Warehouse Inventory Count owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Inventory Count when identity, count integrity, variance basis, approval, or verified posting remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Inventory Count proof and route unresolved item, lot, serial, location, system quantity, physical quantity, and variance scope to inventory control coordinator.
